notes.title: Update #3 Hard Mode (Blood Curse) Now In Game
notes.content:
[h1]Blood Curse[/h1]
New Feature--Blood Curse. Now players can find a mystery elephant to activate Blood Curse. Now only 2 types of curse are available. More choices will be added recently.

[h1]Fatal Error Problem Fixed[/h1]
We have fixed some Fatal Error problems caused by death physic simulation.

[h1]Fix Drinking problem[/h1]
Getting hurt during drinking would cause player stuck in a state that can not attack or dodge. Now it is fixed.

[h1]Attract All Gems[/h1]
Now after 3 seconds of boss death, all gems on the ground will be attracted to player.

[h1]Missing sound of Shaman[/h1]
Now Shaman in Chapter 1 has more sound. 

[h1]Fix slot unlock problem[/h1]
Now you can correctly save your progress of unlocked slots.

[h1]Improve Final Boss Experience[/h1]
Rewrite final boss AI behavior tree, now boss will walk closer to use skills and they will rotate standing and walking period.

[h1]Fix Cloud Save[/h1]
Expand cloud save memory.

[h1]Weapon token Compensation[/h1]
Now if a player died and lost all weapons and have no weapon token, then he will get 3 random weapon token to redeem for any weapon he likes.

[h1]Enemy Adjustment[/h1]

Now wizard in chapter 2 that shoot 3 fireballs has worse tracing ability.

[h1]Added Weapon Exchange in Chapter 3 and 4[/h1]
Now you can save and exchange weapon in the shop room in chapter 3 and 4

[h1]Improve Tree culling in Chapter 2[/h1]
Now trees in chapter 2 would not block vision.

notes.title: Update #2 Bug Fix
notes.content:
[h1]1.Fixed map collision related bug[/h1]
Chapter 1 Boss map, Chapter 3 Boss map etc.

[h1]2.Fixed wall culling[/h1]
Chapter 4 maps now has culling when it blocks vision.

[h1]3. Gem dust[/h1]
Now whether you win or die, all gem will turn into gem dust with 1:10 ratio.

[h1]4.UI Font[/h1]
Fixed fonts of weapon description.

[h1]5.Add slot description[/h1]
Hover mouse on slots now can show description of slot feature.

[h1]6.Ending screen weapon information[/h1]
Now ending screen can correctly show the lost weapon name and pic.

[h1]7.Redeem weapon[/h1]
Fixed a problem of redeem weapon icon.

[h1]8.Fixed player Hp bar/h1]
Fixed a problem when player lost hp in high frequency and heal, then the hp bar is broken.

[h1]9.Fixed initial stat upgrade[/h1]
Now initial stat upgrade can correctly work and be saved.

[h1]10.Fixed lava damage[/h1]
Now lava environment in chapter 3 can deal damage to player.

[h1]11.Rune exchange fixed[/h1]
Now when you choose a target type of runes, the rune exchange will always give you the wanted rune.

[h1]12.Chapter 4 boss fix[/h1]
Now the boss in chapter 4 can switch to phase 2 with individual hp bar and stay in phase 2 for 30 seconds.
